title: Myrna Hansen hypnotic regression and underground facility abduction

tellings.quote: the woman MNA Hansen that she he had coming to his house in the 80s talking about she was talking about being abducted and going to this underground facility

plain: A woman named Myrna Hansen is said to have described being abducted around 1980 near Albuquerque, New Mexico, and taken to an underground facility, memories the story ties to hypnotic regression, the use of hypnosis to bring back supposed hidden memories. The researcher Greg Bishop tells Michels about it in an episode on Paul Bennewitz, a man whose obsession with aliens is the subject of the show, saying Hansen came to Bennewitz's house "talking about being abducted and going to this underground facility." If her account were true, it would place a hidden alien-linked base under New Mexico.
